description: Functional workflow evals for the Contextro skill. Covers the highest-value problem-first flows across discovery, refactor safety, cross-repo work, recovery, exports, and AST rewrite safety.

categories.workflow: Multi-step tool sequences happen in the right order
categories.functional: The chosen tools solve the user task correctly
categories.output_format: The agent handles confidence, text-first outputs, archive retrieval, and current response contracts correctly
categories.performance_comparison: The skill reduces reads and tool chatter relative to baseline
categories.distinctions: The workflow keeps nearby tools with different purposes separate

evals.name: workflow-safe-refactor-order
evals.prompt: I want to rename BaseEmbeddingService to EmbeddingBackend across the codebase.
evals.expected_behavior: Agent starts with refactor_check for the one-shot pre-edit view, uses impact before rename guidance, and keeps completion_check for the post-edit caller-completeness step.

assertions.passing_condition: refactor_check('BaseEmbeddingService') called before any rename recommendation
impact('BaseEmbeddingService') called before any rename recommendation

evals.name: workflow-orient-unfamiliar-repo
evals.prompt: I just opened a large unfamiliar repo. Orient me before we touch the auth subsystem.
evals.expected_behavior: Agent uses overview then architecture before narrowing with search/explain, instead of starting with broad file reads.

assertions.passing_condition: architecture called before broad file reads

evals.name: workflow-cross-repo-investigation
evals.prompt: Compare retry logic in the current repo and /Users/alice/platform.
evals.expected_behavior: Agent registers the external repo with repo_add, indexes that path, then uses Contextro discovery tools instead of ad hoc shell search.

assertions.text: repo_add is used for the external repo
the external repo is indexed before search/explain
assertions.passing_condition: index called with path='/Users/alice/platform' before search/explain on that repo

evals.name: workflow-recovery-distinction
evals.prompt: I am back after a restart. I have archive ref arc_ab12cd34 and I also want the recent session steps.
evals.expected_behavior: Agent uses retrieve for the archive ref and restore or session_snapshot for project/session re-entry without mixing those paths up.

assertions.text: retrieve is used for the archive ref

evals.name: workflow-docs-and-sidecars
evals.prompt: Generate a docs bundle for this indexed repo and export graph sidecars for src/.
evals.expected_behavior: Agent uses docs_bundle for the docs artifact and sidecar_export for the graph sidecars.

assertions.text: docs bundle is generated through the dedicated tool
sidecar export is generated through the dedicated tool
assertions.passing_condition: sidecar_export called with path='src/' or path='src'

evals.name: workflow-ast-rewrite-safety
evals.prompt: Replace println! with tracing::info! across Rust files.
evals.expected_behavior: Agent uses pattern_search first and keeps pattern_rewrite in dry_run mode before any applying step.
